instructor: Selma hoca is perfect in every aspect. She always informs us about out-of-course and practical life related issues and talks in class about up-to-date topics.

The strongest point of the instructor is that she has good intentions.

However, many weak points exist as well. First of all, in my opinion she couldn't properly express herself and explain the course material to us. I found myself not being able to understand the course from the start of the semester and I haven't been able to understand it since, and I am saying this as someone who really tried to engage and understand the course at first. Second, and the weakest point in my opinon, is the lack of clear instructions and the lack of clear expectations from us. We haven't been given any clear explanation of what exactly is expected of us concerning all assignments and exams. Especially for the final project, we never gotten any clear instructions and I've seen many people including myself being confused about what to do. This has affected us greatly when it comes to the progress we made on our final project as we couldn't move forwards without any clear instructions. Another thing I want to mention is that what is expected of us regarding the entire course wasn't specified from the beginning. A catalog grading system was introduced in the middle of the semester, even though it wasn't mentioned in the syllabus. This has greatly affected my and other people's expectations and planning regarding the course. Regarding grading, the lack of clear explanations has also affected exam grading as well. Because no clear explanaiton of what is expected of us was given, I and many other people got unexpectedly low grades because we couldn't satisfy expectations that we didn't know existed.

Syllabus a bağlı davranmıyor. Yapmaya çalıştığı şeyler güzel ancak puanlamayı ve istediklerini doğru bir şekilde öğrencilere yansıtma konusunda büyük problemler var. Moodle'ı daha etkili kullanmalı. Çoğu şeyi ders dışında ofisine gitmeden çok zor öğreniyorsunuz. Attendance a çok önem veriyor. Hocamız isteklerini daha açık ve anlaşılır şekilde moodle veya ders ortamlarında söyleyebilir. Bu yüzden hiç yoktan 1 harf notumuz takım olarak gitmiştir. Sınavları çok puan kırarak okuyor. Dersi not ortalaması yüksek diye aldık ancak zorunlu derslerden bile daha fazla uğraştırdı. Uğraşı çok olan bir ders. Derse gelen konuk iş hayatından insanlar gayet verimliydi ancak notlandırma tam anlamıyla fair değildi.

The instructor has very few positive attributes beyond having good intentions. When it comes to weaknesses, the list is long. She did not seem knowledgeable about the course content, and even if she was, all of my classmates were constantly frustrated. Instead of focusing on the key concepts we needed to understand, she chose to talk about things like her “Galını” and “Italian leather.”

She never clearly communicated her expectations in writing, often just saying, “I am picky,” and portraying herself as a high-level businesswoman who is hard to satisfy. The project process was chaotic. Our group received feedback around five times, but almost never in written form, which made it hard to act on anything specific.

Overall, the experience was terrible. I did not learn anything from the instructor. If I did manage to take away anything from the course, it was solely from reading the slides uploaded to Moodle which, according to her own words, were not “Bilkent level.” She occasionally glanced at her own slides during class and openly admitted, “I do not understand this either, so I cannot explain.”

This course did not meet the standards expected, and the instructor failed to create a productive learning environment.
She is kind and all but nobody knows what she wants about the exams or workload, I believe even she doesn’t. She is putting very high expectations in her mind and not guiding us for it.
